faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Akiva acts as a private detective, trying to solve listener-submitted mysteries.
kurzfassung: Akiva attempts to solve various mysteries and listener cases, ranging from historical disappearances to lost childhood items. The episode features a special interview with a listener whose husband was once featured in a 1987 Geraldo Rivera special about runaways. Rob and Akiva also discuss listener mailbag ideas and select next week's topic.
stichpunkte: Akiva attempts to investigate historical and personal cold cases submitted by listeners.
A listener named Kim shares the story of how she recognized her late husband from a 1987 Geraldo Rivera broadcast.
Clips from the 1987 Geraldo Rivera special featuring Kim's husband are played and discussed.
Akiva looks into other listener questions, including the origin of avocado popularity and urban legends like Marilyn Manson.
The hosts read mailbag submissions and pitch new episode ideas.
The official wheel lands on 'Never have I ever' for the next episode topic.
beschreibung:
RAANAP 328: “Detective” Akiva

Rob Cesternino (@robcesternino) and Akiva Wienerkur (@keev26) need a podcast and every week, Rob and Akiva spin a wheel of listener-submitted podcast ideas, and whatever the wheel lands on is what they podcast about next. This week, Akiva plays “Detective.”

For the link to the spreadsheet that Rob and Akiva use to compile ideas, check it all out here: Rob and Akiva Need a Spreadsheet (compiled by the great Will from America).

To submit an idea for a future episode of “Rob and Akiva Need a Podcast” to be discussed on the mailbag, submit it on this form: Rob and Akiva’s Mailbag Form.
